title: Finance Manager, Sort Center Finance - Middle Mile
description:
North American Sort centers are part of the Amazon Transportation Services which enables next day free delivery for Prime members and seven days a week delivery for our customers. Sort Centers are part of the middle-mile operation; every day several million packages from multiple fulfillment centers across the US and Canada arrive in one of the ~100 sort centers where they are sorted to specific last mile delivery locations, in effect consolidating volumes going to the same place, which improves truck utilization and reduces transportation costs. Since launching operations in 2013, we have provided billions of dollars of savings to Amazon, improved shipping times for our customers and enabled delivery seven days a week - our growing presence in logistics space led Amazon to be one of the top 5 logistic operators in the US.
The North American Sort Center team is responsible for the Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), investment strategy and new transportation initiatives for this operation. This is an exciting opportunity to partner cross-functionally to ensure informed decision making, innovation and sustainability in processes for a growing network. Experience on this team opens up varying career opportunities across Amazon such as transitions to other business lines, project management roles, and/or management opportunities locally, regionally, and globally.
This role will partner directly with multiple senior directors within the Sort Centers network to influence business decisions across operations and finance. A successful candidate effectively manages relationships with business partners, provides sound and thoughtful decision-making, and delineates between competing priorities in a quickly changing environment. The candidate should demonstrate amazing analytical skills, ability to work with ambiguity with strong analytical, verbal, and written communication skills as direct interaction is required with worldwide operations leadership.
Additionally, this is an exciting opportunity to partner cross-functionally to ensure informed decision making, innovation, scalability, and sustainability is achieved for a growing network. The candidate will work with multiple cross-functional teams from Operations, HR, Capacity Planning, Long Term Planning, FP&A, and Tech teams to focus on creating continuous improvement opportunities across internal and external stakeholders to define, design, and maintain performance measurements, reporting and reviews. A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to lead root-cause analysis and uncover core issues to drive cost reductions with stakeholders, manage, evaluate and create meaningful business reporting, and build and maintain complex financial models and analytical tools to measure overall financial performance. Experience on this team opens up varying career opportunities across Amazon such as transitions to other business lines, project management roles, and/or management opportunities locally, regionally, and globally.
A successful candidate effectively influences business partners, provides sound and thoughtful decision-making, and manages competing priorities in a quickly changing environment. The candidate should demonstrate strong verbal and written communication skills as direct interaction with leadership is common.
Key job responsibilities
- Identifies basic control risks, evaluates impact, proposes changes, and implements improvements to remediate gaps
- Delivers weekly/monthly financial performance reports. Uses financial systems and advanced MSExcel functions to work with large data sets. Outputs plans,   forecasts, budgets, and consolidations.
- Works with a variety of data sources. Identifies incomplete or inaccurate data, identifies root causes of data issues, escalates discrepancies, fixes data where possible or partners to deliver a solution.
- Uses active listening skills intuitively to communicate data (both written and verbal) in a   clear, concise, and unambiguous manner. Adjusts style for various audiences to articulate complex finance issues clearly.
- Identifies and implements solutions to resolve, improve, automate, standardize, or simplify finance processes.
- Makes thoughtful time management decisions independently. Prioritizes work, resolves issues, meets deadlines, and seeks feedback from your manager. Discerns between urgent and non-urgent issues and acts accordingly to solve them.
- Drives own self-development in the Finance Community: seeks opportunities to expand finance expertise. Participates in events, initiatives, and projects, then shares gained knowledge in and outside of your team.
- Contributes to work life harmony by being a positive, collaborative, and effective influencer to   new team members.
A day in the life
A typical day in this role provides an opportunity to lead root-cause analysis and uncover core issues to drive cost reductions with stakeholders, manage, evaluate and create meaningful business reporting, and build and maintain complex financial models and analytical tools to measure overall financial performance.
About the team
Amazon’s Sortation Centers are the backbone of the Middle Mile Transportation Operation, enabling 1-day delivery for Prime members and delivery seven days a week for customers. At SCs, we are focused on improving delivery quality and speed while enabling flexibility and cost savings in the transportation network. The Northeast SC region supports 35+ individual sites and continues to scale operations with a focus on continuous improvement to drive best in class results. The team is heavily involved in day-to-day business decisions while providing recommendations on future proposed changes to drive improvement.

title: Finance Manager, Hub Delivery Finance
description:
We are seeking a Finance Manager to join our Hub Delivery Finance team to drive financial processes and deliver high-impact analytics that support our rapidly growing network (>100% annual growth rate). Hub Delivery partners with small businesses to earn incremental revenue with existing space and labor by providing flexible, low-cost delivery service within their community as a 'side-hustle' with minimal upfront investment. In this role, you'll support WW Hub Delivery and partner with senior leadership to drive crucial business decisions, while directly impacting growth strategies and cost improvement initiatives that benefit both Amazon and small business owners in the community.
This position offers a unique chance to work in a dynamic environment where your financial expertise will shape strategic decisions across Amazon Delivery. You'll own critical finance mechanisms, collaborate across finance and business teams, and develop innovative solutions that drive operational excellence. If you're passionate about finance analytics and want to make a meaningful impact in a fast-paced, evolving organization, this role offers exceptional opportunity for growth and influence.
Key job responsibilities
- Partner with individual geo finance teams to manage recurring finance mechanisms including Weekly Business Reviews (WBR), Monthly Business Reviews (MBR), and consolidate worldwide updates for planning cycles while ensuring reporting accuracy and regularly auditing work to maintain the highest standards
- Build and maintain financial models and reporting tools that provide insights on business performance, identify trends, and support data-driven decision making for Hub Delivery operations worldwide
- Proactively analyze financial data to identify opportunities for process improvement and cost optimization, converting data into meaningful findings and providing clear recommendations to senior leadership
- Collaborate with cross-functional and cross-geo teams to develop financial solutions that support business growth while maintaining strong internal controls and financial compliance
- Drive continuous improvement projects that scale and enhance finance operations with measurable results, demonstrating ownership and bias for action in implementing solutions
- Identify and automate manual processes across finance workflows such as data consolidation, reporting, and reconciliation by leveraging AI or other tools to reduce cycle times, minimize errors, and free up capacity for higher-value strategic analysis
A day in the life
Your day starts by reviewing overnight financial performance metrics to prepare for the Weekly Business Review. You'll collaborate with team members to consolidate worldwide updates, ensuring data accuracy before presenting to leadership. Throughout the day, you'll toggle between analyzing financial trends, partnering with business teams to understand operational challenges, and developing improved reporting solutions. You might meet with other Hub Delivery Finance colleagues to align on planning cycle deliverables or work independently to automate a process that will scale across multiple regions.
About the team
The Hub Delivery Finance team is a collaborative group that provides critical financial support for a fast growing worldwide delivery network. As part of the broader organization supporting Last Mile Tech, Pickup and Return Points, and FP&A within Amazon Delivery, our team plays an essential role in driving financial discipline and enabling business growth. title: Senior Benefits Consultant- Benefits Finance
description:
Lead Financial Analysis and Oversight Behind Oracle's Global Benefits Programs

 

Oracle is seeking a Senior Benefits Finance Analyst; this role is responsible for the financial oversight of the company’s health and welfare programs. The role will work with external actuaries, benefit vendors, consultants, and internal Finance partners to develop cost analyses and forecasts, monitor financial performance, and analyze key cost drivers.

 

The position will translate complex healthcare, actuarial, vendor, and financial data into practical insights that support cost planning, program decisions, and longer-term benefits planning for US and support financial information collation and review for International benefits. 

 

The successful candidate will have experience in benefits finance, healthcare finance, actuarial or benefits consulting and should be comfortable working across multiple teams, reviewing complex financial information, and communicating findings clearly and succinctly to key stakeholders.

 

What You’ll Do

 

Financial Management and Reporting

Monitor benefits program financial performance against forecasts and financial plans. 

Analyze monthly and quarterly results and identify the primary drivers of variances. 

Prepare clear financial analyses, summaries, and presentations for Benefits, Finance and other stakeholders. 

Finance Partnership

Serve as the primary liaison between the Benefits organization and Corporate Finance teams, including FP&A, Accounting, Controllers, Treasury, and Procurement. 

Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including accruals, forecasting updates, and cost and spend submissions. 

Coordinate financial reviews and help ensure benefit program costs are represented accurately in enterprise financial plans. 

Partner with Finance teams to strengthen benefits-related reporting processes and internal controls. 

 

Vendor and Actuarial Financial Management

Manage financial relationships with external actuarial firms, consultants, TPAs, and benefit vendors to support forecasting, reserve calculations, funding requirements, and financial reporting. 

Review actuarial assumptions, vendor financial performance, guarantees, invoices, funding requirements, stop-loss recoveries, and contractual financial obligations to ensure financial accuracy and accountability. 

Monitor vendor financial performance and identify discrepancies, risks, or areas requiring further review. 

Partner internally to provide financial analysis on vendor contracts and manage other risk mitigating arrangements (e.g., stop loss) across our entire benefit program. 

 

Financial Governance and Regulatory Compliance

Support benefits-related audits, regulatory filings, and financial reporting requirements, including Form 5500 financial information. 

Assist with internal controls and financial governance relating to benefit funding and vendor payments. 

 

Strategic Planning, Data Analytics and Decision Support

Support program managers and long-term benefits strategy through financial modelling, assess financial impact of emerging trends and identify opportunities to improve cost management. 

Develop financial models and analyses that evaluate healthcare and pharmacy cost trends, vendor performance, funding strategies, and benefit plan changes. Produce executive presentations and recommendations that support strategic investment decisions

Review healthcare, pharmacy, utilization, vendor, and other relevant data to identify cost trends and emerging financial risks.

 Passion for helping customers find creative ways to more effectively run their

 Proactive, results-oriented mindset with a can-do attitude in meeting critical

 Prior team leadership, solution leadership, or management experience preferred.

 NetSuite, Oracle EPM, PBCS, EPBCS, or Oracle certification is a plus.

title: Finance Manager, GPU, Workload Health
description:
Finance Manager, GPU – Workload Health
Location, Nashville TN, or Remote/US
 
Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is one of the fastest-growing divisions within Oracle, and the OCI Finance team plays a critical role in supporting this growth. The Workload Health team is responsible for financial planning and modeling for specific product families within the broader OCI ecosystem. As a trusted advisor to OCI leadership, the team focuses on optimizing business economics while scaling rapidly.
In this Finance Manager role, you will serve as a strategic partner to the product and engineering organizations, with end-to-end ownership of the GPU portfolio. You will lead a small team of direct reports, managing complex financial projects that span across the product lifecycle. Your responsibilities will include guiding financial decision-making, building and refining financial models, and providing actionable insights to drive business outcomes.
The ideal candidate will have a strong data-driven mindset, advanced modeling expertise, and a proven ability to navigate both the high-level strategic and granular operational details. This role requires someone who thrives in a dynamic environment and can effectively collaborate with leadership and cross-functional teams at all levels of the organization.
Main Responsibilities include:
Serve as Trusted Advisor to Engineering: Partner closely with engineering leadership to offer financial insights and guidance, ensuring alignment between product development and financial objectives.
Lead Financial Analysis of GPU Products: Oversee and manage financial analysis within the GPU Portfolio, providing insights to drive business decisions and product optimization.
Optimize Gross Margin: Drive margin optimization across the GPU portfolio by creating & analyzing pricing, cost structure, efficiencies & other operational drivers.
Align Business Strategy with Financial Reporting: Translate business strategy into actionable financial reports, using KPIs and goal-setting to measure success across various GPU product offerings.
Influence Investment Decisions: Guide investment decisions through comprehensive financial analysis, ensuring alignment with strategic goals.
Contribute to Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP): Collaborate with cross-functional teams in the S&OP process to ensure capacity investments for GPU products are timely, appropriately sized, and aligned with business needs.
Drive Financial Policies & Procedures: Develop and implement financial policies and procedures that support the operational goals of the GPU product portfolio and enhance business performance.

title: NA Sales Representative, Data Platform - SLED Pennsylvania
description:
Data Platform Sales Executive – State & Local Government - Pennsylvania 
Our Mission
Oracle’s State & Local Government team helps public-sector organizations use data, cloud, and artificial intelligence to better serve their communities.
State and local agencies are modernizing critical systems, strengthening cybersecurity and resilience, improving constituent experiences, and preparing their data estates for the next generation of AI. These organizations manage some of the most important and sensitive workloads in the country, and they need trusted technology partners who understand both their mission and the complexity of government transformation.
Our goal is to help agencies unlock the value of their data, modernize with confidence, and build secure, governed, AI-ready technology platforms that deliver measurable outcomes for the people they serve.
We are looking for an experienced Cloud & Data Sales Executive to help lead that mission across an assigned State & Local Government territory.
The Opportunity
This is not an account-maintenance role.
You will own the strategy to develop new business, expand existing customer relationships, and create long-term growth across a defined geography or set of named accounts. You will work with government executives, technology leaders, agency stakeholders, partners, and Oracle specialists to identify high-value modernization opportunities and turn them into successful customer outcomes.
The strongest candidates will be builders. They will be comfortable creating demand, developing whitespace, earning executive access, navigating complex public-sector buying environments, and leading strategic sales cycles from initial discovery through adoption and consumption.
You will help customers address priorities such as:
• Modernizing legacy databases and applications.
• Establishing secure and governed data foundations.
• Preparing enterprise data for artificial intelligence.
• Improving analytics and data-driven decision-making.
• Increasing infrastructure resilience and operational efficiency.
• Reducing technology complexity and cost.
• Supporting better constituent and employee experiences.
• Enabling cloud, multicloud, and distributed cloud strategies.
What You Will Do
• Own the territory and account strategy for Oracle Data Platform growth across assigned State & Local Government customers and prospects..
• Build and execute account plans that connect agency mission priorities, technology strategies, budgets, procurement paths, and business outcomes..
• Create pipeline through proactive prospecting, whitespace development, executive engagement, partner collaboration, and identification of new workloads..
• Develop trusted relationships with government executives, CIO organizations, agency technology leaders, architects, developers, procurement teams, and business stakeholders..
• Translate customer priorities into compelling Data Platform, cloud, analytics, application modernization, and AI opportunities..
• Lead complex sales cycles from discovery and qualification through solution development, business case creation, procurement, negotiation, close, adoption, and expansion..
• Coordinate Oracle account teams, cloud engineers, solution specialists, customer success resources, partners, contracts, marketing, and executive leadership..
• Understand each customer’s existing technology environment, modernization roadmap, security requirements, procurement processes, contract vehicles, budget cycles, and partner ecosystem..
• Position Oracle’s differentiated value against competing cloud, database, data platform, and AI solutions..
• Develop executive-level value propositions that clearly connect Oracle technology to mission, operational, financial, and constituent outcomes..
• Engage systems integrators, independent software vendors, cloud partners, and other ecosystem participants to improve customer success and accelerate opportunity development..
• Maintain a high-quality pipeline, accurate forecast, clear opportunity strategy, and disciplined next steps..
• Stay engaged beyond the initial sale to support adoption, workload growth, customer value realization, and cloud consumption..
• Share customer feedback, market insights, and competitive intelligence with Oracle leadership, product teams, and go-to-market organizations..
• Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual sales, adoption, and consumption objectives..
The Oracle Data Platform
Oracle provides a comprehensive enterprise technology platform that helps government organizations manage, secure, integrate, analyze, and activate their data across cloud and on-premises environments.
The portfolio includes capabilities across:
• Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
• Oracle Database and Autonomous Database.
• Database migration and modernization.
• Data warehousing, lakehouse, and analytics.
• Data integration and application integration.
• Artificial intelligence and machine learning.
• AI Vector Search and generative AI use cases.
• Application development and modernization.
• Multicloud and distributed cloud.
• Security, governance, resilience, and disaster recovery.
The role is not focused on selling individual products in isolation. You will help customers develop a practical path from their current environment to a modern, secure, governed, and AI-ready technology platform.
What We Are Looking For
Required Qualifications
• Demonstrated success selling enterprise technology, cloud infrastructure, database, data platform, analytics, artificial intelligence, or related solutions..
• Proven experience developing new business, creating pipeline, and expanding complex enterprise or public-sector accounts..
• A record of meeting or exceeding sales targets within an assigned territory or portfolio..
• Experience leading complex sales cycles involving executive, technical, financial, legal, procurement, and partner stakeholders..
• Ability to understand business and technical requirements and communicate complex technology value in clear customer terms..
• Strong account planning, opportunity management, negotiation, forecasting, and executive presentation skills..
• Ability to build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and key customer influencers..
• Ability to operate independently while coordinating a broad virtual sales team..
• Strong judgment, curiosity, accountability, and follow-through..
• Willingness to travel within the assigned territory based on customer and business needs..
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience selling to State & Local Government agencies, public-sector organizations, or similarly complex regulated customers..
• Understanding of government procurement, funding and budget cycles, contract vehicles, cooperative purchasing, and public-sector decision-making..
• Experience selling cloud consumption, database modernization, data and analytics platforms, AI solutions, or application modernization..
• Experience creating opportunities in greenfield, underdeveloped, or highly competitive territories..
• Established relationships with government technology leaders, agency executives, partners, or industry influencers within the assigned market..
• Experience working with systems integrators, independent software vendors, and public-sector partner ecosystems..
• Familiarity with competitive cloud and data platform technologies and the ability to position differentiated business and technical value..
• Experience connecting technology investments to measurable mission, operational, and financial outcomes..
What Success Looks Like
Successful sellers in this role do not wait for opportunities to appear. They create them.
They understand the customer’s mission, develop a point of view on where Oracle can create value, and bring the right people and resources together to move opportunities forward. They build executive relationships, maintain strong technical credibility, navigate procurement and budget complexity, and stay engaged through customer adoption and consumption.
Success will be measured through:
• Sustainable pipeline creation.
• New customer and workload development.
• Expansion within strategic accounts.
• Cloud adoption and consumption growth.
• Executive and technical relationship development.
• Quality of account and opportunity plans.
• Forecast accuracy and sales discipline.
• Effective use of partners and Oracle resources.
• Customer outcomes and long-term value realization.
• Achievement of quarterly and annual objectives.
Why Oracle
Oracle offers the opportunity to help government organizations modernize some of their most important systems and data environments.
You will join a team focused on solving meaningful customer challenges, expanding the use of trusted enterprise technology, and helping public-sector organizations prepare for a future increasingly shaped by data and AI.
You will have access to a broad portfolio, experienced technical resources, executive support, an extensive partner ecosystem, and the ability to help customers modernize across cloud, multicloud, distributed cloud, and on-premises environments.
Join us and help State & Local Government organizations turn trusted data into better decisions, stronger operations, and improved outcomes for the communities they serve.

title: Customer Growth Strategy Senior Manager | Financial Services
location: New York, One Manhattan West, Corp
description:
We Are
Accenture Song accelerates growth and value for our clients through sustained customer relevance. We bring together strategy, creativity, and technology to help organizations imagine and deliver growth across brand, business, product, marketing, commerce, and service. With deep industry expertise and strong client partnerships, we help financial services leaders design and execute growth strategies that solve real customer needs and deliver measurable outcomes.
You Are
 
A seasoned growth strategist with years of experience translating vision into execution and measurable value. You are passionate about solving customer problems in ways that drive lasting impact, and you thrive at the intersection of growth strategy and operational delivery. You are equally comfortable working shoulder-to-shoulder with client executives and leading teams to execute complex transformations. Beyond shaping strategies, you are adept at embedding within client relationships, partnering with Accenture account leads, and identifying new opportunities, both organic and inorganic, that grow Accenture Song’s impact and our clients’ businesses. You are also a thought leader, energized by developing provocative perspectives on the future of financial services and packaging them in ways that drive new conversations, opportunities, and growth.
You bring depth across human-centered design, commercial strategy and technology-led transformation. You can move from customer evidence and emerging technology signals to a compelling executive growth thesis, a prioritized opportunity portfolio, a fundable business case and an enterprise delivery agenda. You understand how AI-enabled delivery and enterprise AI capabilities can accelerate both the work we perform and the growth solutions we create for clients
 
The Work
As a 
Senior Manager, Customer Growth Strategy
, you will help F
inancial Services 
organizations reimagine how they grow by aligning customer needs, business objectives, and technology investments to create measurable value.
Growth Strategy & Business Transformation
Partner with senior Financial Services executives to develop enterprise growth strategies across brand, product, marketing, commerce, customer experience, and service.
Translate ambitious growth visions into actionable roadmaps, operating models, and investment priorities that drive measurable business outcomes.
Identify, prioritize, and activate growth opportunities that deliver revenue expansion, customer acquisition, retention, and profitability improvements.
Build multi-horizon portfolios of growth initiatives, balancing near-term impact with long-term transformation objectives.
Client Leadership & Growth Origination

Embed within client relationships and collaborate with Accenture account teams to identify, shape, and originate new business opportunities.
Develop compelling executive-level narratives and business cases that connect customer insights, market trends, strategic choices, and financial outcomes.
Contribute to the growth of Accenture Song through opportunity development, proposal shaping, and client relationship expansion.
Customer-Centered Innovation
Lead human-centered innovation programs that transform customer insights and unmet needs into differentiated businesses, products, services, and experiences.
Guide opportunity discovery, concept development, validation, and investment decision-making using desirability, viability, and feasibility frameworks.
Lead customer journey transformation efforts and define the people, process, data, technology, and operating model changes required to deliver improved experiences at scale.
AI-Enabled Growth & Enterprise Innovation
Advise clients on the implications of emerging technologies, including enterprise AI, and translate those trends into actionable growth strategies.
Integrate AI-enabled approaches into client engagements to accelerate insight generation, decision-making, delivery effectiveness, and value realization.
Guide organizations in responsible AI adoption, governance, change management, and enterprise scaling strategies.
Leadership & Team Development
Lead multidisciplinary teams across strategy, research, design, analytics, technology, and operations.
Coach and mentor practitioners while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and high performance.
Partner across Accenture to bring together creativity, technology, and intelligence to deliver end-to-end growth solutions.
Thought Leadership
Develop and commercialize industry-leading points of view on Financial Services growth, customer behavior, AI, and business transformation.
Represent Accenture Song in client conversations, executive forums, industry events, and market-facing thought leadership initiatives

10+ years of experience in growth strategy, customer strategy, innovation, business transformation, or management consulting.
Proven track record of originating, shaping, and closing strategic opportunities within client accounts.
Experience developing and implementing growth strategies that deliver measurable business results, including revenue growth, customer acquisition, market share expansion, or operational efficiency.
Demonstrated success leading client engagements and managing senior stakeholder relationships.
Experience leading cross-functional teams across multiple workstreams and complex transformation initiatives.
Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Deep Financial Services experience across banking, payments, wealth management, insurance, or capital markets.
Experience developing growth strategies, customer experience strategies, or business transformation programs.
Strong business case, financial modeling, and value realization experience.
Experience identifying, shaping, and selling new consulting opportunities.
Strong executive communication, presentation, and storytelling skills.
Experience applying customer research and human-centered design methods to develop products, services, or experiences.
Experience leading AI-enabled strategy or transformation programs.
Ability to build trusted relationships with senior executives and influence key decisions.
MBA or other advanced degree preferred.

Additionally, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the Company's legal duty to furnish information.
